r:
nvread

Runs TPM2_NV_Read

[-hia
hierarchy authorization (o, p)(default index authorization)]
-ha
NV index handle
[-pwdn
password for NV index (default empty)]
[-sz
data size (default to size of index)] counter, bits, pin read 8 bytes, extend reads based on hash algorithm
[-cert
dumps the certificate
01c00002
RSA EK certificate
01c0000a
ECC EK certificate
[-ocert
certificate file name, writes in PEM format
[-off
offset (default 0)]
[-of
data file (default do not save)]
[-id
data values for pinCount and pinLimit verification, (4 bytes each)]

-se[0-2] session handle / attributes (default PWAP)

01
continue
40
response encrypt
